hypothesis: A newly trainable native Go recurrent write/forget state update can learn an information-bearing 576-byte associative state from PUBLIC relationship observations, beating same-architecture untrained and zero-state readout under balanced future-question counterfactuals. Fixed token hashes, outer-product tensor operation and four-step composition remain programmed.
design: Two independent update mechanisms: fixed .91 decay+supervised 4-feature learned write gate, versus prediction-sensitive learned write coupled to dynamic retention .72+.24*write. Train 4 learned gate weights plus learned query gain and bias: six native float64 parameters, 48 model bytes separate. Native 12x12 float32 resident 576-byte state. Training via 38 deterministic coordinatewise central finite-difference BCE steps per architecture on 24-example rotating development minibatches. All expected future questions known only to DEVELOPMENT loss, withheld during each state's 12 public observations and all inference.
dev_only: Train on NEW seeds35328..35351 ×2 prior development grammars×4 balanced counterfactual link variants (192 graph states/384 queries); validate on disjoint new seeds35392..35403 ×2 different grammars×4 (96 states/192 questions). No sealed cohort reserved, accessed or dispatched by this gate. New mechanisms must not be conflated with the earlier NCI11 weak diagonal SPSA changes.
controls: Compare each trained model to the identical initialized model and trained-readout zero-memory ablation, both with the same 576-byte resident state cap. Also compare against existing coded NCI09 from frozen prior archived qualification in narrative only; direct equal-cost baseline on the new tasks is required BEFORE any sealed claim. Model and resident memory bytes separately reported, training steps and wall milliseconds measured. No equal FLOP/total heap inference.
qualification: Select most causally supported development candidate, require >=70% validation, >=10pp over same-architecture untrained, >=10pp over trained zero-memory readout and >0.01 L2 trained param change. Preserve negative even if workflow passes. Do not consume any sealed first-use until independent development archive audit, resources, and future heldout source freeze.
governance: Research-only GitHub hosted Actions and one complete Go regression. No new FSA, NCI01 full acceptance, AGI, RSI, external LLM, paid API, FORGE R32/R33, CKB-plane/KTRADE/controller, merge, accepted refs or production. 45/45/10 effort allocation target, actual compute mix unmeasured.
